# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    cpu = resource_score(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
    return float((cpu + mem) // 2)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the

# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def latency_penalty(node: NodeState) -> float:
    n: int = len(node.latency_to_ms)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    total: float = 0.0
    for k in range(n):
        total = total + node.latency_to_ms[k]
    return total / float(n)

def power_penalty(node: NodeState) -> float:
    return (node.power_idle_w + node.power_max_w) * 0.5

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    cpu = resource_score(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
    if cpu == 0 or mem == 0:
        return -1000000.0
    headroom = float((cpu + mem) // 2)
    lat = latency_penalty(node)
    power = power_penalty(node)
    if node.suspended:
        return headroom * 0.5 - lat * 1.0 - power * 0.02
    return headroom - lat * 1.0 - power * 0.02

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def latency_penalty(node: NodeState) -> float:
    n: int = len(node.latency_to_ms)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    total: float = 0.0
    for k in range(n):
        total = total + node.latency_to_ms[k]
    return total / float(n)

def load_penalty(node: NodeState) -> float:
    if node.cpu_capacity == 0 or node.mem_capacity == 0:
        return 1000.0
    cpu_frac = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_frac = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    return cpu_frac + mem_frac

def queue_penalty(node: NodeState, pod: Pod) -> float:
    if node.cpu_capacity == 0 or node.mem_capacity == 0:
        return 1000.0
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    cpu_frac = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_frac = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    return cpu_frac + mem_frac

def power_penalty(node: NodeState) -> float:
    return (node.power_idle_w + node.power_max_w) * 0.5

def find_pod_index(pod: Pod, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> int:
    n: int = len(ctx.pods)
    for i in range(n):
        p = ctx.pods[i]
        if p.current_node == pod.current_node and p.service == pod.service and p.app == pod.app and p.cpu_request == pod.cpu_request and p.mem_request == pod.mem_request:
            return i
    return -1

def latency_to_node(node: NodeState, target: int) -> float:
    if target < 0:
        return 0.0
    n: int = len(node.latency_to_ms)
    if target >= n:
        return 0.0
    return node.latency_to_ms[target]

def graph_penalty(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    idx = find_pod_index(pod, ctx)
    if idx < 0:
        return 0.0
    total: float = 0.0
    count: int = 0
    for e in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        src = ctx.graph.src[e]
        dst = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        if src == idx or dst == idx:
            other = dst
            if src != idx:
                other = src
            other_node = ctx.pods[other].current_node
            if other_node >= 0 and other_node < len(ctx.nodes):
                lat = latency_to_node(node, other_node)
                total = total + lat * 2.0
                total = total + load_penalty(ctx.nodes[other_node]) * 20.0
                count = count + 1
    if count == 0:
        return 0.0
    return total / float(count)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    cpu = resource_score(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
    if cpu == 0 or mem == 0:
        return -1000000.0
    headroom = float((cpu + mem) // 2)
    graph_pen = graph_penalty(pod, node, ctx)
    avg_lat = latency_penalty(node)
    queue_pen = queue_penalty(node, pod)
    power_pen = power_penalty(node)
    suspend_pen: float = 0.0
    if node.suspended:
        suspend_pen = 1000.0
    return headroom * 1.0 - graph_pen * 8.0 - avg_lat * 2.0 - queue_pen * 30.0 - power_pen * 0.02 - suspend_pen

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
